text: On it — proxy middleware fix in progress (nil-safe balancer `Next` + 503 when no target). ETA ~5 min.
Noted. Investigating `router.go` for the no-routable-path case (likely a panic/incorrect result when the path has no routable segments). ETA ~15 min, will confirm once fixed and the suite is green.

Fixed and verified. `middleware/proxy.go`: both `randomBalancer.Next` and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` now return nil when the target list is empty (previously `rand.Intn(0)` / `% 0` panicked), and `ProxyWithConfig` returns `echo.ErrServiceUnavailable` (503) when the balancer yields no target instead of dereferencing nil. Verified with a throwaway test covering empty/emptied balancers (503, no panic) and the full suite: `go test ./...` all green.

Noted — `Context#Scheme()` in context.go: it must ignore invalid `X-Forwarded-Proto` values (falling back to `X-Forwarded-Protocol`) and ignore invalid forwarded headers entirely, defaulting to `http`. ETA ~12 min.
Noted — `group.go`: multiple groups registered on the same path must each run their own middleware (the per-group middleware chain is being shared/overwritten). ETA ~12 min.
